Chapter 550: Chapter 7: Aren’t You Just Entering the Ninth Rank? (Please Subscribe)

The Three-Headed Alien Race decided to make a move against the Galaxy Master for three main reasons.

First, the Galaxy Master had just risen to the Ninth Rank—how strong could he be?

Being a Ninth Rank Myriad Layer Realm powerhouse himself, even if the Galaxy Master was exceptionally talented, at most, he wouldn’t be able to kill him, feeling entirely capable of retreating unscathed.

The Insect Race Alliance and the Human Alliance were sworn enemies anyway. Whether he attacked the Galaxy Master or not, their grudges wouldn’t lessen, and if the Galaxy Master had a chance to kill him, he wouldn’t hesitate.

Secondly, this place is the Xuanhuang Secret Realm. The powerhouses who enter here are basically avatars, and the Galaxy Master is definitely no exception.

Since it’s an avatar, it won’t carry significant treasures with it, and if the Three-Headed Alien Race encountered the real body of the Galaxy Master, they probably wouldn’t act rashly.

...

Given the Galaxy Master’s innate talent and aptitude, human civilization has surely left many provisions on him. He’s merely a Ninth Rank; how could he withstand the Peak Clans’ contingencies?

But in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm? Given that it’s an avatar that entered here, the Three-Headed Alien Race believed there was still a chance.

Thirdly, it’s about the bounty from the Insect Race. The Insect Race, to delay the growth rate of the Galaxy Master, would spare no effort.

…

On the other side.

Lin Yuan easily killed a hundred-meter-tall giant bear, casually taking the ‘Mystic Yellow’ Crystal.

The giant bear had just entered the Ninth Rank, and its core ‘Mystic Yellow’ Crystal was the size of a thumb, worth no more than a few thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

But a mosquito is still meat, Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t scorn it, equivalent to picking it up for free.

“This trip into the ‘Mystic Yellow’ Secret Realm, whether or not I can figure out the ‘calling sensation’, it’s still profitable…”

Lin Yuan felt pleased.

All this was money, all of it.

Just as Lin Yuan was about to merge into the Spatial Layers and continue on his way.

Hum.

All around, unexpectedly, black mist began to pervade.

The black mist penetrated many Spatial Layers, dimly encircling Lin Yuan as its center, condensing into a black cage that encompassed more than twenty thousand Spatial Layers.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s expression subtly changed.

“Is it a Different Species?”

Lin Yuan’s mind shifted, merging into the Spatial Layers as well.

The native life of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, though powerful, attacked in rather rigid ways, unlike this refined black mist trying to trap Lin Yuan.

“Galaxy Master!”

Just as the black mist formed a cage, a Three-Headed Alien emerged, smiling softly at Lin Yuan, “Who would have thought that the famous Galaxy Master would be encountered by me?”

“Is it you?”

“Oliven!”

Lin Yuan had initially planned to escape the black cage first.

The black cage covered more than twenty thousand Spatial Layers, posing a challenge to any Ninth Rank powerhouse who had developed fewer than twenty thousand layers to escape easily.

However, Lin Yuan had developed up to forty-three thousand layers, far surpassing the depth of twenty thousand layers.

So escaping the cage was easy.

Yet, upon seeing the powerhouse who made a move against him was a Three-Headed Alien, Lin Yuan immediately had other ideas.

The Three-Headed Alien, named ‘Oliven’, was a somewhat famous Ninth Rank powerhouse from the Insect Race Alliance, having developed twenty-six thousand layers of space.

Just from the number of Spatial Layers alone, Lin Yuan could sweep Oliven aside.

Not to mention Lin Yuan’s true combat power. His Inner World, reaching over a billion square miles, placed Lin Yuan’s real strength on par with those controlling hundreds of thousands or even millions of Spatial Layers.

Faced with Oliven, this Ninth Rank executioner from the Insect Race Alliance who had killed countless Human Evolvers on the Large Alien Battlefield, Lin Yuan also harbored a killing intent.

Mainly because the opponent had come to him, and his strength was far below his own, and there were no Ninth Rank powerhouses from the Insect Race Alliance nearby to support him.

“Die.”

The Three-Headed Alien didn’t waste words. Believing he had the advantage, the quicker he killed the Galaxy Master, the better, to avoid unnecessary complications.

Rumble.

The ubiquitous black mist began to contract, and the Three-Headed Alien’s form dispersed, similarly transforming into black mist, merging with the surrounding black cage.

This was also the special skill of the Three-Headed Alien Race, leveraging its innate racial talents to completely merge into the space.

This is a complete merger, not just entering the many Spatial Layers.

“Galaxy Master, don’t blame me.”

A smile appeared on the face of the Three-Headed Alien, as if seeing the Galaxy Master reduced to dust under the contracting black mist.

To kill a peerless human genius, even just an avatar, brought immense satisfaction to the Three-Headed Alien.

However.

The next moment.

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, gently grasping in front of him.

This grasp wasn’t limited to the main space but encompassed the numerous Spatial Layers, all the black mist thoroughly gathered into Lin Yuan’s palm.

The Three-Headed Alien, merged into the black mist, thought initially he was invincible, but under this grasp, he too fell into Lin Yuan’s palm.

“This is—” the Three-Headed Alien’s expression drastically changed, facing Lin Yuan’s grasp, he tried to flee deeper into the Spatial Layers, only to discover that no matter which layer he escaped into, he had to face this grasp.

“You’re not just newly advanced to Ninth Rank?”

In the midst of fright and unwillingness, the Three-Headed Alien just managed to utter this before seeing Lin Yuan’s right hand swiftly clench, all the black mist and the Three-Headed Alien himself utterly obliterated in this grasp.

The Ninth Rank Myriad Layer Realm Three-Headed Alien died.

“With this level of strength, you still came to kill me?” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

If the Three-Headed Alien had seen Lin Yuan and immediately fled, he might have survived, especially in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, where Lin Yuan didn’t want to cause too much commotion.
